The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf1578546653fc5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix D < ∞. Let f, g be centered even observables of norm at most one, supported respectively in BDs(x) and BDs(y), where s ≥ 1 and |x − y| = ls. For sufficiently large l, uniformly in s, x, y and in the observables, E0fg = l−2 κqs(f)qs(g) + oD(1)  , (2.13) |qs(fg)| ≤ CDl−u . (2.14) If each observable is invariant under quarter turns about its own center after auxiliary integration, the last bound improves to CDl−w. The term oD(1) tends to zero as l → ∞ independently of s.
